entries.name: Remote Desktop Commander
entries.inputContract: Authorized endpoint command request with nonce payload.
entries.outputContract: Completion record proving nonce execution on the authorized Windows endpoint.
entries.notes: Historical observation only; no live session is implied.

entries.name: GitHub connector
entries.inputContract: Read-only repository metadata request.
entries.outputContract: Repository listing or file metadata for the current repository.
entries.notes: Current evidence is read-only access to this repository.

entries.name: GitHub CLI
entries.inputContract: Authenticated GitHub read command.
entries.outputContract: Command success/failure plus repository-readable output.
entries.notes: A historical repo-absence result is retained only as superseded evidence and not treated as current.

entries.name: Copilot
entries.inputContract: Issue or pull request implementation request.
entries.outputContract: Repository changes and test artifacts on the active PR branch.
entries.notes: This suite is being implemented by Copilot in this PR, not by a WD-local Codex session.

entries.name: Codex CLI/session
entries.inputContract: Local Codex session bootstrap request.
entries.outputContract: Established local coding session metadata.
entries.notes: No local Codex session was established in the parent observations.

entries.name: WSL Ubuntu
entries.inputContract: Remote uname or shell command against Ubuntu in WSL.
entries.outputContract: Kernel and distribution details.
entries.notes: Ubuntu reported a WSL1 kernel, not WSL2.

entries.name: NCBI Datasets
entries.inputContract: Selected versioned assembly accession panel with hash verification.
entries.outputContract: Downloaded versioned assemblies and metadata manifests.
entries.notes: Prior selected-input panels remain inputs until verified; no assemblies are fabricated here.

entries.name: GToTree
entries.inputContract: Annotated proteomes or genome inputs plus marker set selection.
entries.outputContract: Conserved marker family sets and alignment-ready bundles.
entries.notes: No completed analysis is claimed.

entries.name: HMMER
entries.inputContract: Protein sequences and marker HMM profiles.
entries.outputContract: Profile hits with thresholds and family assignments.
entries.notes: Evidence-bound declaration only.

entries.name: Alignment and trimming tools
entries.inputContract: Per-family protein or nucleotide sequence sets.
entries.outputContract: Separate alignments and trimmed outputs per family.
entries.notes: Stage intentionally remains separate per marker family.

entries.name: IQ-TREE
entries.inputContract: Prepared alignment sets and model-selection parameters.
entries.outputContract: Host tree inference artifacts and model summaries.
entries.notes: No host tree is fabricated in this repository.

entries.name: DefenseFinder
entries.inputContract: Genomic loci or proteomes for defense-system detection.
entries.outputContract: Candidate defense and R-M locus calls.
entries.notes: Independent R-M detection remains unexecuted here.

entries.name: REBASE
entries.inputContract: Restriction-modification enzyme reference lookup.
entries.outputContract: Reference annotations for R-M review.
entries.notes: Reference-only until externally verified.

entries.name: PubMed/Entrez
entries.inputContract: Literature or accession queries.
entries.outputContract: Linked records or citations for locus review.
entries.notes: No manuscript or private data retrieval is performed here.

entries.name: Geneious
entries.inputContract: Local sequence review project inputs.
entries.outputContract: Human review workspace artifacts.
entries.notes: Optional unprobed integration.

entries.name: iTOL
entries.inputContract: Host tree plus verified ring annotation tables.
entries.outputContract: Four-ring visualization assets.
entries.notes: No ring outputs are fabricated.

entries.name: BioNeMo/NIM
entries.inputContract: Installed-skill listing or NIM skill resource lookup.
entries.outputContract: Skill catalogue entries or skill-read result.
entries.notes: Listed installed skills, but actual skill read returned resource-not-found; no NIM API or GPU job executed.

entries.name: smarts.bio
entries.inputContract: Catalogue browse or named tool execution request.
entries.outputContract: Catalogue entries, tool execution receipt, or explicit no-execution reply.
entries.notes: Catalogue/execution mismatch: 87 tools listed, 404 on bio_gc_content, and smarts_query answered manually for synthetic ACGTACGT with no tool executed.

entries.name: Genomic Intelligence
entries.inputContract: External genomics-analysis task request.
entries.outputContract: External result receipt requiring reviewer verification.
entries.notes: Optional and unprobed; never silently authenticated.

entries.name: AlphaGenome
entries.inputContract: Explicit coordinate system, input alphabet, and bounded retry policy for transient failures.
entries.outputContract: Versioned engineering-reference outputs only.
entries.notes: Engineering-reference only; not a LAB classifier and no non-MIT assets are copied or relabeled.

entries.name: native ChatGPT Sites
entries.inputContract: Native Site deployment or receipt lookup.
entries.outputContract: Deployment receipt.
entries.notes: Native ChatGPT Sites were not exposed to the parent observer, so no native deployment receipt exists.
